title: Piano players of the district: Steve Lewis and Piron
summary: He names Steve Lewis and others as the best pianists back of town and says Lewis played with Piron.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Do you remember any other guys that played piano like that?

Steve Lewis, uh, this Jackson, Udell, I don't know what his last name was, he played back there. Oh, there was, there was a, there was a, there was some white fellas played back there, I think Buzzy Williams played back there. Uh, but the, the, the, the three that I can remember the most was Steve Lewis and, uh, and Udell.
How did Steve Lewis play? Fine, played wonderful.

He played, well, he, he, uh, he played a lot with Piron. And, uh, and then later on, he played out at, they had an ice cream pallet out at Spanish Fort. Well, the way he played with Piron was out at Spanish Fort too, but it was a private restaurant, Tranchinas, was called Over the Rhine, it was over the base, over Canal-like, you know. It was right across from Spanish Fort, they called it Over the Rhine.
